description: Returns the input schema, an example input, the price and the fit record (what the framework does for this decision by model, before paying) for one of the applied decisions (reinvest or distribute, build or run for cash, cash cycle, runway, owner pay, hurdle rate, concentration, pace of growth, price, adjacency; and, in the market branch, verdict, pricing power, binding node, rent, shock). Free. Call it before bf_apply_decision to learn which numbers the rule needs and what each one means; without `decision` it lists them all. Do not guess missing inputs to fill the schema: ask the user for the figures the business actually has.

decision.description: Decision path, e.g. "risk/decide/hurdle". Omit to list the fifteen.

name: bf_decision_schema

outputSchema.description: Without `decision`: the list of applied decisions with prices. With one: its input_schema (JSON schema), example_input, price_usd, how, and fit (what the framework does for this decision by model, before paying).

title: Business Frameworks: decision input schema
